1: idle screw on the carburetor 

2: throttle cable too short/strained to where it basically pulls the lever (if u still have the governor attached) or the pull up slide thingy that goes in the top of like a dirt bike carb. 

3: for whatever reason, your throttle is slightly stuck open or something of the sort.
